data.summary: Attempt 2 passes the automated gate. `npm test` in ui/ exited 0 with 52 tests, 52 passing, 0 failing, and `npm run build` exited 0; both results come from the factory's pre-executed runs, and I did not re-run them. The theme logic, the inline no-flash script in Layout.astro and the Header/ThemeToggle wiring match the acceptance criteria by code inspection. Criterion 6 (dark-mode readability across all pages and modals) and the browser-only checks were not executed and remain unverified.

executedCommands.command: npm test (cwd ui/, pre-executed by factory)
npm run build (cwd ui/, pre-executed by factory)

e2eChecks.name: Header Home/About boxes (light mode active state)
e2eChecks.expected: Active link has black background and white text in light mode
e2eChecks.actual: activeLink = 'border-black bg-black text-white dark:border-slate-500'; applied to Home or About on both desktop and mobile lists

e2eChecks.name: ThemeToggle beside PrivacyToggle (desktop and mobile)
e2eChecks.expected: ThemeToggle rendered next to PrivacyToggle in both header variants
e2eChecks.actual: ThemeToggle client:load follows PrivacyToggle in the md:flex block and in the md:hidden block

e2eChecks.name: Persistence and html class on explicit selection
e2eChecks.request: Code inspection of theme.js setTheme/applyTheme and ThemeToggle select()
e2eChecks.expected: Dark sets class 'dark' and localStorage theme='dark'; Light removes the class and stores 'light'
e2eChecks.actual: setTheme persists the value and applyTheme toggles the 'dark' class; covered by unit tests (persists the preference and applies it, removes the dark class when the preference is light)

e2eChecks.name: System preference and live OS change
e2eChecks.request: Code inspection of theme.js subscribeToSystemTheme and ThemeToggle
e2eChecks.expected: System + OS dark gives class 'dark'; OS change updates class without reload
e2eChecks.actual: subscribeToSystemTheme listens to the matchMedia 'change' event and reapplies only when preference is 'system'; covered by unit tests

e2eChecks.name: No flash on reload (inline script before first paint)
e2eChecks.expected: Inline script in head reads localStorage and sets the dark class before body renders
e2eChecks.actual: is:inline script in <head> reads localStorage 'theme', resolves system via matchMedia and toggles 'dark' on documentElement

e2eChecks.name: Dark-mode readability across page, header, cards, tables, modals
e2eChecks.request: Visual check in browser on / and /about at desktop and mobile widths
e2eChecks.expected: Dark backgrounds with light text everywhere
e2eChecks.actual: Not executed: no browser available to QA. Dark classes were added to the touched components, but the diff does not show every table and modal covered. Developer lists the chart tooltip as unthemed.

e2eChecks.name: resolveTheme unit tests and npm test/build green
e2eChecks.request: npm test and npm run build in ui/
e2eChecks.expected: Exit 0 for both, resolveTheme tests pass
e2eChecks.actual: npm test exit 0, 52/52 pass including the resolveTheme group; npm run build exit 0

evidence: theme.test.js is a new file; no existing test was deleted, skipped or disabled in the diff.
ForecastUtils and ChartUtils tests still appear as passing in the suite output.
No assertions were loosened in the diff.

bugReports.title: Chart tooltip is not themed for dark mode
stepsToReproduce: Set the theme to Dark via the header ThemeToggle.
Hover a data point to show the custom tooltip (getCustomTooltip).
bugReports.expected: Tooltip uses dark background with light text in dark mode.
bugReports.actual: Developer report lists the custom tooltip HTML as not themed; it is likely to keep light styling.
bugReports.evidence: Developer report followUps: 'Chart tooltip custom HTML (getCustomTooltip) is not themed for dark mode.' Not verified in a browser.

bugReports.title: No component-level test for ThemeToggle or the InvestmentGraphModal MutationObserver
stepsToReproduce: Inspect ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js and the test list.
Search for tests covering ThemeToggle.jsx or InvestmentGraphModal.tsx.
bugReports.expected: Event and storage sync and chart color switching are covered by tests, as AGENTS.md asks for comprehensive tests for new classes.
bugReports.actual: Only the theme.js helpers are unit tested. ThemeToggle's event/storage listeners and the MutationObserver chart colouring have no tests.
bugReports.evidence: The only new test file is ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js; the Developer report testsAdded lists only that file.

data.recommendation: Before merge, verify the dark-mode visuals in a browser at / and /about (desktop and mobile widths) and fix any unreadable tables or modals. Then theme the custom tooltip returned by getCustomTooltip in ui/src/components/modals/InvestmentGraphModal.tsx, reading the 'dark' class on document.documentElement the same way the chart colours do. Optionally add a test for ThemeToggle's THEME_CHANGE_EVENT and storage listeners.
